# Rule 11 — Ahelp, staff interaction, and appeals
Use adminhelp when you need staff assistance, want to report a rule issue, or are unsure whether something is allowed.
Be honest in adminhelps. Do not lie to staff, hide important context, spam adminhelp, or use adminhelp to insult, threaten, or argue with staff.
If staff contact you, respond when possible. Ignoring staff during an active issue may make the situation worse.
Do not handle rule violations through revenge or out-of-character arguments. Report the issue and let staff deal with it.
Staff decisions during a round are final for that round. If you believe a decision was wrong, use the proper appeal or complaint process after the round instead of disrupting the game.
